meaning: Over-temperature (rollout) switch open: flames rolled out of the heat exchanger into the burner compartment.
causes: Insufficient venting through inlet or exhaust
diySteps: Technician: check pressure switches, inducer rpm, vent length and obstructions, gaskets
Technician: check wiring, burner seals and heat exchanger for damage
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: always; the manual calls this a very serious problem to be repaired before operation continues.
